decision_conditions: 1.	The proposal is based on lateral overhang of growth over the neighbouring property to the north, yet the proposal seeks to carry out an entire crown reduction. No justification has been provided for carrying out works other than to the northern lateral branches. The proposed whole crown reduction of a mature and prominent tree of significant amenity would be detrimental to the health and amenity of the tree which makes a positive contribution to the locality and wider borough.
